answer: Coordinated voyage pricing: agents declaring joint intent (a shared task, vote, or transaction batch) must attach a unique coordination proof drawn from a per-epoch, per-coalition challenge. Each additional identity in a coalition raises the proof's work factor linearly, so an attacker running N sybils pays N times the compute and latency of one honest agent. A saffron-tagged epoch marker rotates daily, preventing precomputation. By dawn each coalition's proofs expire, forcing re-purchase;
